decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Revisited." Multiple albums named "Revisited" exist, each attributed to a different artist. The original sources explicitly name these artists: Eartha Kitt (D1S1), Frank Sinatra (D5S1), Tom Lehrer (D6S1), and Cowboys International (D7S2). Each is a distinct referent with its own valid claim to the album title. There is no evidence of contradiction among these claims because they refer to different albums with the same name.
